text:
incident-bot: PAGERDUTY -> P0: runtime containers in us-west-2 GPU pool are crashlooping with SIGSEGV. Error rate spike at 23:21 UTC, several customer requests failing. Paging on-call.
Mira: on it. seeing repeated segfaults in runtime-engine v2.3.1 on startup. logs: `terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'\n  what():  runtime kernel failed: segfault (signal 11)`
Jae: I can take primary. adding labels + pulling logs from node gpu-3. Can someone post the minimal stack trace?
Mira: paste from container log (truncated):
```
[2026-03-15T23:20:58Z] loading kernels...
[2026-03-15T23:20:59Z] fused_attention_init() at fused_kernels.cu:431
[2026-03-15T23:20:59Z] Exception: invalid device pointer
[2026-03-15T23:20:59Z] Segmentation fault (core dumped)
```
Mira: looks like the crash happens during fused kernel init; v2.3.1 enabled newer fused path for TensorRT-like kernels.
Priya: taking node-level visibility. nodes/gpu-3 shows OOM_kill? Not exactly, kernel panic not OOM. I'll cordon gpu-3 and drain pods to limit customer impact.
Sam: critical: two enterprise customers (cust-omega, cust-lyra) reported errors in the last 10m, ~12% of requests 500ing across the pool.
Eve: flagging product + support - need external comms if this persists >30m.
Jae: immediate mitigation proposal: disable fused kernels for runtime, fallback to safe path. We can set env RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED=1 and trigger rolling restart of the runtime deployment. That should avoid the device-initialization segfault.
Mira: confirm quick test: `kubectl -n inference set env deploy/runtime RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED=true` then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime`. doing patch now on canary subset (10%)
deploy-bot: Deploy task queued: patch runtime (namespace: inference) by Jae. Rollout started on canary.
Mira: canary shows healthy for 2 replicas, no segfaults in logs after 40s. promoting to full rollout.
Priya: cordoned node gpu-3 and drained. no pending pods left. marking node for deeper hardware check by infra tomorrow.
Sam: support notes: cust-omega saw 47 errors; cust-lyra 12 errors. both on hosted API via us-west-2. I've opened support tickets and linked to 1871234567.
Jae: done full rollout. runtime pods stable now. error rate dropping back to baseline. removing paging escalations.
incident-bot: incident status changed -> mitigation in progress. severity=P1 -> downgraded to P2 (customer impact limited, mitigated by rollout).
Mira: follow-ups: collect core dumps from affected pods (if any). if core exists, `gcore` or `kubectl cp` to get /var/crash. Also save the full container logs to s3: `s3://redwood-incidents/1871234567/`.
Priya: leaving handoff to night oncall @Jae -> @Priya (next shift). Priya will handle any node flaps and follow infra diag.
Jae: handing off. summary: segfaults during fused kernel init in v2.3.1 -> mitigated by disabling fused kernels and rolling restart -> customer impact limited. next steps: reproduce on a test rig with the same driver/kernel; collect core dumps; prepare a patched runtime image that disables the fused path or guards the pointer init.
Eve: can we prepare a short customer-facing blurb? I'll draft once we have attribution.
Sam: tickets updated, customers notified of temporary mitigation, ETA for full fix TBD. assigning eng-runtime to postmortem.
Mira: adding postmortem task: reproduce + root cause (kernel pointer null on certain GPU driver combos) + plan (hotfix image v2.3.2 + automated canary gating for fused kernels).
Jae: I'll stay on until 00:30 UTC then Priya takes over. leaving logs and steps in the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1871234567
Priya: acknowledged, taking overnight ownership. ping me if errors resurface.
Mira: thanks all. closing incident channel once overnight stable for 30m. collecting artefacts now. \n
